FAQs

Frequently asked questions

How much does rotator cuff repair cost in Gachibowli at Apollo Hospitals?
Rotator Cuff Repair cost typically ranges ₹1.5-2.5 lakhs at Apollo Hospitals Financial District, depending on implant choice, insurance, and complexity. Most major insurers cover the procedure cashless. WhatsApp Dr. Harsha's team for a personalized estimate.
What is the recovery time after rotator cuff repair?
Most patients recover in 4-6 months. You'll be guided through structured physiotherapy from day 1. Light routine activities resume in 1-2 weeks; full activity (driving, heavier work) timelines depend on your individual case.
Is Dr. Harsha experienced in rotator cuff repair?
Yes — Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy is a Senior Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon at Apollo Hospitals with 15+ years and 4,000+ surgeries. He is fellowship-trained at Continental Hospitals in both Arthroplasty and Arthroscopy.
How do I book an appointment with Dr. Harsha?
The fastest way is WhatsApp at +91 99599 64567 — typical reply within 30 minutes. You can also call directly. Apollo Hospitals is at Financial District, Nanakramguda — about 15-20 minutes from most parts of Hyderabad.
Is Dr. Harsha available for second opinions?
Absolutely. Many patients come for a second opinion before deciding on surgery elsewhere. Bring your existing reports — Dr. Harsha will give you a transparent, conservative-first opinion. No pressure to switch your primary doctor.
